messages:
Rae (UX): saw a user struggle with tool-calling results in today's testing. idea: add a slim "schema preview" gutter to the playground run history. shows expected output fields and quick validation state (ok/warn/error) per invocation. reduces guesswork vs opening the full payload.
Tom (Frontend): gutter sounds neat. is it per-invocation row or sticky to the timeline?
Rae (UX): per-invocation row by default, collapsible into a sticky left rail when many rows selected. keep it opt-in in prefs.
Bea (Design): visual: tiny table of keys + types, with colored dot (green/yellow/red). when user hovers a red dot show inline reason: e.g., "missing required field 'price'". also add small link "Open schema editor".
Omar (Eng-ML): we already compute lightweight validation when we run evals. we can run a fast schema-check server-side and attach a small summary to the invocation metadata. avoid re-parsing heavy outputs client-side.
Nina (PM): analytics we care about: preview_opened, schema_mismatch_seen, jump_to_schema_editor, expand_full_output_after_mismatch. helps measure if preview reduces full-open rates.
Tom (Frontend): accessibility: gutter must be reachable by keyboard, screen-reader friendly labels like "Invocation 123 schema status: mismatch" and tooltips exposed via aria-describedby. chevrons need focus styles.
Bea (Design): microcopy proposal: green dot label "Matches schema"; yellow "Partial match"; red "Schema mismatch 17 details". keep language simple.
Rae (UX): edge case: streaming tool outputs may update validation state as chunks arrive. plan: show provisional state and then final when run completes. announce changes with aria-live=polite.
Omar (Eng-ML): implementation: add small validation summary to invocation proto: validation:{status: "ok|warn|error", messages:[...short strings...]}. no heavy arrays. front-end can request details when user clicks.
Nina (PM): rollout: feature flag on; default off for orgs with >10k runs. measure impact on time-to-debug and support tickets tagged "schema confusion".
ops-bot: feature flag queued: schema-preview-gutter -> canary.
Tom (Frontend): dev notes: render minimal summary inline to avoid DOM bloat. fetch messages on demand. persist user pref (preview_gutter=true/false) to account settings. estimate 4 frontend days + 2 backend days.
Bea (Design): accessibility checklist: keyboard nav to gutter cells, aria-live for streaming updates, readable color contrast, tooltip copy for screen readers, and an option to switch to text-only mode.
Rae (UX): follow-ups: I'll add a short mock GIF showing hover and aria-live announcement. also will propose exact wording for the hover details.
Nina (PM): I'll add analytics event names to the ticket and a simple dashboard for mismatch rate over time.
Tom (Frontend): starting a small WIP branch, will ping @Rae @Bea for copy and a11y review.
Rae (UX): thanks everyone 12 this should help a lot with structured output debugging.
